reserveReview.rationale: The issuer API currently reports 34,938.93380119589 USDU-equivalent in the Morpho adapter and 22,684.14844672596 in the Curve adapter, with only 5.12e-10 in TermMax. At the current Ethereum block, the Curve pool held 30,867.799174 USDC and 19,228.491520291005 USDU. Splitting the API-valued Curve position by those constituent balances and normalizing to total backing yields 60.63% Morpho USDU self-exposure, 15.11% Curve USDU self-exposure, and 24.26% external USDC collateral. The live API remains the source of adapter totals; the pool split is an on-chain constituent classification rather than a supply override.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current USDU issuer backing API with an on-chain constituent split of the Curve LP position
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All material adapter backing is classified; the 5.12e-10 TermMax residual is below display precision and does not create a material unresolved exposure. USDU-denominated vault and LP positions are retained as self-reserve rather than false upstream dependencies.
